steps.outcome: Found chall.png and chall.py at the filesystem root.

steps.milestone: Inspected the challenge generator and identified shuffled QR chunks
steps.outcome: Source showed a version 7 QR code split into shuffled chunks.

steps.outcome: The image was 450 by 450 grayscale with binary-looking pixels.

steps.outcome: No finder patterns were detected in the candidate blocks.

steps.milestone: Tested steganography extraction and metadata inspection
steps.outcome: Steghide did not support the PNG; metadata confirmed grayscale PNG properties.
